description: This file defines the OAuthTokensController class, which manages OAuth token deletion within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for deleting tokens and redirecting upon deletion.

classes.name: OAuthTokensController
classes.description: Controller class for managing OAuth tokens, including deletion and post-deletion actions.

methods.name: action_delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified OAuth token record after access control checks.

methods.name: post_delete
methods.description: Handles redirection after deletion, based on request parameters.
